name: 李宜庭
objective:
先修課程：微積分或負責教授同意。常微分方程式、線性常微分方程式、拉普拉氏轉換、級數及傅立葉級數、線性代數及矩陣、積分定理。
Introduction of the deformation, Strain and stress of structure (Beam, Column, Pressure vessel) under different loading conditions such as Tension, Compression, Shear force, Torsion and Bending moment.
schedule:
週次	章節內容	備註
01	Course introduction & Basic Concepts and Ideas	
02	Geometrical Meaning of y’=f (x,y) & Separable Differential Eq.	
03	Exact ODES & Linear ODEs	
04	Determinants (Second-/Third-order; Properties; Cramer’s Rule).	9/28 教師節
05	Inverse of a Matrix & Gauss–Jordan Elimination.	Quiz
06	Homogeous Linear ODEs. of Second Order & Euler-Cauchy Eq.	
07 	Existence and Uniqueness of Solutions & Nonhomogeous ODEs	
08 	Mid-term exam	9/26 光復節補假
09	Solution by Variation of Parameters & Homogenous Linear ODEs of High Orders	
10 	Homogeous Linear Eq. of High Orders with Constant Coefficients & Nonhomogeous Linear ODEs of High Orders	11/09 校慶慶祝大會暨園遊會補假
11	Power Series Method & Theory of the Power Series Method	
12 	Line Integrals; Path Independence; Double Integrals; Green’s Theorem.	Quiz
13 	Legendre’s Equation; Legendre Polynomials Pn (x) & Frobenius Method	
14 	Bessel’s Equation. Bessel Functions Jv (x) & Laplace Transform	
15 	Transforms of Derivatives and Integrals. ODEs & Unit Step Function	
16 	Final exam	
17	透過提講義，協助學生進行自主學習
(Short Impulses; Convolution. Integral Equations)	自主學習
18 	透過提講義，協助學生進行自主學習
(Differentiation and Integration of Transforms)	自主學習
scorePolicy: 平時 40%(內含小考 30%，平時出缺席考核與課堂行為觀察 10%，點名缺席一次扣 1%，最多扣至 10%)，期中考 25%，期末考 25%，自主學習作業 10%。
materials:
1.	自編教材
2.	Erwin Kreyszig, Advanced Engineering Mathematics, 10th edition,
consultation: 學生可利用 office hours 現場或使用 email 聯繫討論。
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
remarks: 彈性學習 / Flexible Learning 一、類別 (可複選)□學生自主學習二、內容 (1) 第 17 週: 依照當週課程提供講義供學生自主學習。(2) 第 18 週: 依照當週課程提供講義供學生自主學習。三、時數總共 6 小時。四、學習成果第 17 週繳交相關習題作業；第 18 週繳交相關習題作業。五、評量比例習題作業: 10%
